work.title: Autumn Weatherization and Heating Preparation
work.overview: Tightening window sashes, servicing heating circuits, and sealing exterior draft points before hard frosts arrive.

work.title: Settling into North Hollow
work.overview: The first summer in the house: unpacking, opening the garden, and the two repairs that could not wait.

work.title: Orchard Harvest, Cider Pressing, and Cold Storage
work.overview: Gathering apple bushels, pressing winter cider, and storing root vegetables in the cellar.

work.title: Keeping the house
work.overview: The upkeep that comes round on its own, and the small jobs that turn up between the big ones.

work.title: The garlic bed for next summer
work.overview: Hardneck garlic along the south wall, in the ground before the frost and under straw for the winter.

work.title: Drainage, Storm Doors, and Sill Protection
work.overview: Hanging winter storm sashes, draining rain barrels, and clearing perimeter downspouts.

work.title: Root Cellar and Winter Crop Preservation
work.overview: Curing squashes, packing carrots into damp sand, and lime-washing stone foundation walls.

work.title: Window Sash and Glazing Restoration
work.overview: Rehanging counterweights, bedding loose glass with linseed putty, and tuning sash locks.

work.title: Autumn Cider Press Run
work.overview: Harvesting Northern Spy and Russet crops, washing carboys, and pressing sweet and hard cider.

work.title: Shelves in the pantry bay
work.overview: Seven fixed shelves of poplar for the jars, the bottom one left high enough for the crock.

work.title: Boiler, Radiators, and Wood Stove Tune-Up
work.overview: Bleeding iron radiators, checking circulator pressure, and cleaning stovepipes before lighting first fire.

work.title: Put up the summer
work.overview: Pickles, peach jam, tomato sauce. The jars on the middle cellar shelf.

work.title: Paint the back bedroom
work.overview: Wash, fill and prime the cracked plaster, two coats on the walls and the trim in the old cream.

work.title: Rebuild the back porch steps
work.overview: The stringers are soft at the foot and the second tread gives. New stringers, new treads, the old nosing kept where it is sound.

work.title: Open the spring garden
work.overview: Turn the beds the last people left, feed them, and get the seedlings out after the last frost.

work.title: Unpack and find a place for everything
work.overview: Kitchen first, then the beds, then the books. The study last, because it can hold the boxes until then.

work.title: Upkeep through the year
work.overview: The rhythms live here: filters, gutters, the dehumidifier, the knives, the kettle and the cars.
